newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: DHAKA STOCKS SEEN MIXED AHEAD OF WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: DHAKA STOCKS SEEN MIXED AHEAD OF WEEKEND.

text.p: Dhaka stocks are likely to be mixed on Thursday as brokers expect another session of lacklustre trading ahead of the weekend.
Friday and Saturday mark the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
"The bear-run is most likely to continue. Prices may move in a narrow range and results will remain mostly mixed, " said broker Khurshid Alam.
He said the market needed massive support from institutions to boost the "shattered" confidence of retailers.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index dropped 21.53 points or 2.27 percent to 925.02 on Wednesday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-869749
